name: fight_act1_dror_ragzlin
title: Act 1 boss: Dror Ragzlin's throne room
about: Fight (family 1), a boss with a large crowd: the goblin warlord in the Shattered Sanctum's throne room and the goblins around him. claude-run-2 S018 killed him and 13 goblins with many downs, no reload.

start.needs_save: Act 1, the Shattered Sanctum outside Dror Ragzlin's throne room, the camp still neutral, Priestess Gut already dead in her chapel (claude-run-2 S017-pre-dror): party level 3, companions (Wyll, Gale, Shadowheart). Avatar named Tav (a paladin, Oath of Devotion), Karmic Dice off, Balanced, out of combat with no dialogue open, saved as SCN-<name> (docs/SCENARIOS-AUTHORING.md).

note.where: The Shattered Sanctum, at the throne room's door; the goblins are not hostile yet.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
